storage: volume JSONL <archive>/epacamd/TX_<year>Q<quarter>.jsonl(.gz) — one file per calendar quarter
source: EPA Clean Air Markets Division (CAMD) CEMS streaming API (api.epa.gov/easey), emissions/apportioned/daily + facilities/attributes endpoints, stateCode=TX pilot
license: Public domain (U.S. EPA, 40 CFR Part 75 Continuous Emissions Monitoring). Attribution: 'U.S. EPA Clean Air Markets Division (CAMD)'.
attribution: U.S. EPA Clean Air Markets Division (CAMD)

field_map.stateCode: US state postal code (TX only, v1 pilot scope)
field_map.unitId: EPA unit id within the facility
field_map.date: operating date (YYYY-MM-DD, local to the reporting period)
field_map.countOpTime: hours in the day with any reported operating time (0-24)
field_map.sumOpTime: sum of fractional operating-time hours across the day — direct utilization ground truth
field_map.grossLoad: sum of gross load (MW) readings for the day — direct output ground truth
field_map.steamLoad: sum of steam load readings for the day (steam units only, else null)
field_map.so2Mass: SO2 mass (tons), null where the unit doesn't monitor it
field_map.co2Mass: CO2 mass (short tons), null where not monitored
field_map.noxMass: NOx mass (tons), null where not monitored
field_map.primaryFuelInfo: primary fuel type as reported to EPA
field_map.unitType: boiler/turbine/etc. classification as reported to EPA
field_map.lat: facility latitude, joined from facilities/attributes (null if lookup missed)
field_map.lon: facility longitude, joined from facilities/attributes (null if lookup missed)
field_map.ownerOperator: owner/operator string as reported to EPA, joined from facilities/attributes
field_map.rt: as-seen UTC date (WE fetched it, not the report date)

confidence_model: government-reported unit-level CEMS data, treated as ground truth (this is itself the gate-1 truth source for satellite/imagery power-utilization inference roots, not a claim needing external validation). Point-in-time vintage: a quarter is re-fetched while within 45 days of its own quarter-end (EPA's documented finalization window) and a value change re-archives as a NEW row with a new rt, never overwriting; once sealed (45+ days past quarter-end, already archived) a quarter is never re-fetched. The utilization/output SIGNAL interpretation for any downstream trading use is gate-2-locked and not surfaced from this raw record.
cadence: quarterly (NOT daily/real-time despite daily granularity within each record — a quarter only becomes queryable once fully closed, live-probed 2026-07-18); polled every 12h, at most one quarter-data API call per poll (see pickQuarterToFetch), shared DEMO_KEY fallback when EPA_CAMD_API_KEY is unset (wishlist 9a)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here. v1 pilot scope is stateCode=TX only (matches GRID VISION's existing ERCOT focus and keeps shared-DEMO_KEY usage trivial); widening to more states is a follow-up filed in wishlist.md once a dedicated key is set. Facility-level geo makes this a /data-registry-layer candidate for a future PR (not shipped this session — pipeline+API first, same sequencing precedent as usaSpending.ts).
